fullDescription: ForgeMotion is a cinematic, dark-themed design system optimized for high-end creative tools, SaaS dashboards, and game development platforms. The style is defined by a 'Dark Tech' aesthetic, pairing deep black canvases (#000000) with sophisticated bronze-gold accents (#412700, #8a5a1c). It features futuristic, geometric typography ('Tomorrow') with extreme letter spacing, immersive 3D WebGL hero backgrounds, and glassmorphic micro-components. The layout utilizes a minimalist navigation bar and a horizontal marquee-style showcase for feature exploration.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, high-contrast dark mode design system utilizing bronze metallic accents, futuristic display typography, and real-time 3D motion elements to convey a professional yet cutting-edge creative engine feel.

style.description: The design system uses a primary palette of black (#000000) and white (#ffffff) with bronze gradients (#412700 to #8a5a1c) for calls to action. Typography pairings include 'Tomorrow' for futuristic, uppercase display headings and 'Inter' for clean, legible body text. Visual depth is achieved through 3D wireframe meshes, subtle border-bottom lines (#ffffff10), and backdrop-blur effects (4px) on interactive states.
style.prompt: Create a design system with a pure black background (#000000) and high-contrast white text (#ffffff). Use the 'Tomorrow' font family for all display and UI elements, using 'Inter' only for long-form body text at 16px with a 1.6 line-height. Color palette: Brand Bronze (#412700), Bronze Light (#8a5a1c), Body Grey (#999999), and Dark Grey Buttons (#1d1d1d). Navigation and labels must use 10px-12px uppercase font with 0.4em letter spacing. CTA buttons should be rounded-full (nav) or 8px border-radius (hero) with a solid bronze fill and white text. Implement glassmorphism using 'backdrop-filter: blur(4px)' and 'border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'. Animations should include slow 3D rotations, subtle hover lifts (translateY -4px), and opacity fades for overlays.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical stack starting with a high-transparency fixed header, an immersive hero section featuring a full-width WebGL canvas, and a horizontally scrolling 'Marquee' showcase of feature tiles.

prompts.partPt: Menu do Topo Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt: A thin, absolute-positioned top bar with a 1px border-bottom (#ffffff10). Space-between layout with a 24x24px SVG logo on the left, a centered row of uppercase links (12px Tomorrow, 0.4em tracking), and a 'Get Started' bronze pill-shaped button on the right. Side padding: 24px.

A relative container with min-height 640px. A WebGL canvas covers the entire background. Centered over this is a vertical text stack: a micro-label 'FORGEMOTION' in 14px Tomorrow with extreme tracking, a primary H1 heading in 40px Tomorrow, and a constrained body paragraph (max-width 600px). Below text, a dual-button group: Primary (Bronze) and Secondary (Dark Grey with border).

A full-width horizontal scrolling container ('marquee-row') with no visible scrollbar. Features 'showcase-tile' elements (280px width, 380px height). Each tile has a 16px border-radius, a 1px border-white/5, and high-saturation gradient backgrounds. Tiles must feature a glassmorphic micro-label in the top left and an internal animation element (e.g., spinning ring, pulsing shape).

special_ui_components.description: A feature-showcase card with reactive hover states.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a 280x380px card with a 16px border-radius. Background is a vibrant gradient or dark pattern. Top-left: A pill-shaped chip (#000000cc) with backdrop-blur, 1px white/10 border, and 10px uppercase text. Center: A large kinetic element (rotating border or pulsing SVG). On hover: The tile lifts -4px and a 40% black overlay with 2px backdrop-blur fades in smoothly.

A Three.js IcosahedronGeometry wireframe. Use LineBasicMaterial with bronze color (#c9862f) and 0.55 opacity. Add a secondary PointsMaterial layer for vertex highlights. Implement slow continuous Y-axis rotation (0.12 speed) and subtle X-axis oscillation. Ensure transparency (alpha: true) to let the background #000000 show through.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Use 'Tomorrow' for all caps titles and tracking-widest (0.4em) for a tech-heavy look. MUST: Ensure the background is always #000000 for maximum depth. MUST: Use subtle border lines (#ffffff0d) instead of heavy boxes. DO NOT: Use standard blue/primary colors; stick strictly to the bronze and grayscale palette. DO NOT: Use rounded corners larger than 16px for cards or 8px for primary buttons.
